name: Hidden doubles play: doubles matches in the last 7 days and at this event
model_overlap: none (rough x: R2 0.034 men / 0.023 women on the 49 non-price inputs; corr with sets_14d 0.03-0.04; data/studies/unpriced_leads/team/rhythm_body/novelty.json)
exposed_2025_26: partly: the lens (schedule-and-body unpriced in 2025-26) comes from edge_anatomy's 2025-26 ledger; no 2025-26 result of this statistic was read
disposition: G5 member (doubles at other events, days -7..-1)
lead_note: doubles at the same event read nothing
definition: For each player before the match: D7 = doubles matches played on clock days d-7..d-1 (d = this match's best-estimate day), any level, split into D7_here (same event) and D7_else, with doubles sets as a load variant; x = log1p(D7)_A - log1p(D7)_B and the two parts separately. Men 2013-17 (no doubles days on disk): 1[entered in this event's doubles draw] (known at the draw) and doubles matches at the previous event.
mechanism: Singles prices, our model and sets_14d see singles only. Doubles is competitive match play in today's conditions without the survival/form signal of singles wins, so it separates rhythm from survival behind the unpriced sets_14d and U-138; its load is invisible to a singles trader.

name: Doubles-aware rust: surface layoff counting doubles
definition: L_any = days since the player's last match, singles or doubles, on this surface; x = [log1p(surf_layoff singles) - log1p(L_any)]_A - same_B, the rust the singles record overstates; an any-surface version beside U-132.
mechanism: Surface rust is unpriced (surf_layoff, in the model) but is measured from singles only; doubles on the surface reduce real rust while the market, like the model, reads the singles record.

name: Rest in hours before the match (short turnaround)
model_overlap: low (rough x: R2 0.029 men / 0.023 women; corr with sets_14d 0.07-0.08)
definition: rest_h = this match's start (UTC; at bet time the scheduled start from the order of play) minus the end of the player's previous played match (Flashscore end_utc, else its start plus Stage 0 minutes), any level; x = s(rest_A) - s(rest_B) with s(h) = max(0, 24 - h)/24; variants 1[rest < 20 h] and log hours.
mechanism: Players, bettors and models count days; a night finish followed by an early start costs sleep and recovery that 'played yesterday' does not distinguish, and lines are set the evening before.

name: Same-round turnaround gap between the two players
model_overlap: low (R2 0.014 men / 0.012 women; corr with sets_14d -0.03)
definition: When both players' previous matches ended within 72 h: x = clip(rest_h_A - rest_h_B, -36, 36)/12, else 0; secondary: the same restricted to equal rest in days (the day-session against night-session gap).
mechanism: Nobody quotes the opponent's rest in hours; a day-session winner and a night-session winner meet the next day 10-12 h apart in recovery.

name: Recovery ratio after a long match
lead_note: priced: the line moves against it (z -10.2)
definition: For previous matches of 150 minutes or more: r = rest_h / (previous match minutes / 60); x = [log(1 + 1/r)]_A - same_B (0 when the previous match was shorter or rest exceeds 72 h).
mechanism: Muscle damage and glycogen loss scale with duration: 4 hours then 18 hours is not 1 hour then 18 hours; the market sees the long match, not the ratio.

name: Late finish then early start (event-relative)
definition: late = 1[the player's previous match was the last to end on its day at its event] (time-zone free) x 1[this match is first or second on its court today]; x = late_A - late_B.
mechanism: Night sessions and rain backlogs push finishes past midnight; the next day's early slot is a sleep deficit that the day count hides.

name: Heat stress x heat acclimatisation
lead_note: Burke et al. 2023: the previous match's heat is priced
definition: H = max(0, WBGT - 25 C) over the match's hours for outdoor matches (WBGT from hourly temperature, humidity, radiation and wind at the venue; 0 indoors); Acc_X = sum over X's matches in the 14 days before of max(0, WBGT_j - 22) exp(-days_j / 7); x = H (Acc_A - Acc_B) / sd.
mechanism: Both players face the same heat, so prices move little; acclimatisation builds over one to two weeks and depends on where a player came from (indoor Europe or clay to Australia or the US summer), which no line tracks.

name: Heat tolerance trait: home climate and body size in the heat
definition: x = H (Clim_A - Clim_B) / sd with Clim = the mean summer WBGT of the player's country (Stage 0 country; training base where known); companions H (height_A - height_B) and H (age_A - age_B).
mechanism: Heat tolerance differs with the climate a player is used to and with body size; the market prices famous cases, not the gradient.

name: Women's heat-break and medical history (WTA umpire log)
lead_note: near U-179 (physio: retirement risk, not results)
definition: For women: shrunk count of the player's matches in the last 12 months with a heat break (reason HeatBreak10Minutes or Heat) or a physio or medical treatment; x = diff, and H x that history.
mechanism: Who needed treatment in the heat before is a direct sensitivity label the market does not compile.

name: Style-specific ageing: age x the return share of the long-memory edge
exposed_2025_26: partly: age's 2025-26 ledger reading (men z -2.0) seen
lead_note: signs flip by tour and era
definition: Drift_X = (age_X - 29)+ x RS_X, RS_X = Dbar / (|Obar| + |Dbar|), Obar and Dbar the means of X's standardised per-surface IOS offence and defence values (per-player store columns pp__ios_srf*), optionally x the profile's memory (years since its median match); x = Drift_A - Drift_B.
mechanism: Movement and return skills fade earlier than serving; the market prices 'veteran' as one number and the long-memory profile lags decline, so ageing returners stay over-rated. The model sees age only as A - B and cannot apply A's own curve.

name: Career mileage beyond age (full careers)
exposed_2025_26: partly: U-158 was scored on windows that include 2025-26
definition: Odo_X = log(1 + career matches at every level up to the match) minus its age-expected value (fitted on cohorts before 2013); x = [(age - 27)+ Odo]_A - same_B and Odo_A - Odo_B.
mechanism: Wear: at equal age, more career matches means an older body; the market prices age, not mileage.

name: Years past the player's own peak
definition: Peak_X = the maximum of X's overall Elo to date; YPP_X = years since it; x = [(age - 27)+ min(YPP, 5)]_A - same_B; companion: the 24-month slope of the level.
mechanism: After a peak, decline tends to continue; ratings and reputations lag it.

name: Qualifier and lucky-loser arrival cost
exposed_2025_26: partly: U-176 was scored on windows that include 2025-26
lead_note: it is the qualifier tag (r 0.998), spanned by the inputs
definition: For a qualifier or lucky loser in the first main-draw match: Qcost = log1p(points played in this event's qualifying), Qrest = hours since the qualifying final ended (as RB03), LL = 1[lucky loser]; x = Qcost_A - Qcost_B (0 for direct entrants); secondary LL x On (U-138).
mechanism: The market prices the Q tag ('the dangerous qualifier', match-tight) but not what the run cost or how little rest followed. LL against Q separates on-site rhythm (both have it) from survival (the LL lost).

name: The bye seed's cold start against an opponent with on-site matches
exposed_2025_26: partly: the lens (schedule-and-body unpriced in 2025-26) comes from edge_anatomy's 2025-26 ledger; no 2025-26 result of this statistic was read
disposition: G5 member (the bye seed's cold start)
lead_note: the signal inside U-138; concentrated in 2017-19
definition: At events with first-round byes (draws 28, 48, 56, 96): in the bye seed's first match, x = log1p(On_opponent) x log1p(days since the seed's last match), signed toward the seed; else 0.
mechanism: The expanded 12-day 1000s made bye-seed matches common; the opponent has played here, the seed has only practised.

name: Recent retirement or walkover given, any level, without a long break
exposed_2025_26: partly: B-INJ (with this injury flag) was tested once on 2025-26, unresolved
lead_note: signs opposite by tour, no mechanism
definition: R28_X = 1[X retired or gave a walkover in any match in the 28 days before, with no 42+ day break since]; x = R28_A - R28_B; companion count over 90 days.
mechanism: A player back within weeks of a retirement is a health question that the model reads as a short rest; the earlier test used a truncated main-tour-only history.

name: Withdrawal from an entered event in the last five weeks
definition: W35_X = 1[X withdrew from an event whose main draw began in the 35 days before], split by stated reason (injury or illness against other); x = W35_A - W35_B.
mechanism: The singles record shows the gap as rest; a withdrawal for injury says it was not. News covers top players, not the rest of the draw.

name: Conditions-matched rust: same surface, indoor status and court pace
definition: CM_X = log1p(days since X's last match with the same surface, the same indoor status and a venue pace within one SD of this venue's), capped at 365; x = CM_A - CM_B beside the model's surf_layoff; companion: an altitude band (1,000 m or more) in the matching key.
mechanism: The surface label hides indoor against outdoor, fast against slow and altitude; surface rust is unpriced in the model, and the finer adaptation cost is less visible still.

name: Altitude arrival
definition: At venues of 1,000 m or more: x = [log1p(days on site at altitude)]_A - same_B; companion: altitude x (iosO_ace_A - iosO_ace_B).
mechanism: Thin air speeds the ball; players just down from sea level need days; venue character is known, adaptation is not.

name: Real time-zone shift with days to adapt and direction
lead_note: travel closed by the literature and the pool (U-151)
definition: dz = the UTC offset of this venue minus that of the player's previous match venue (city-level table with daylight saving); T = days from that match to this one; JL = |dz| max(0, 1 - T/|dz|), x 1.5 eastward; x = JL_A - JL_B.
mechanism: Circadian adaptation takes about a day per zone; no line does the arithmetic of zones and days.

name: Excess on-site cost (struggle against cruise)
lead_note: priced: the line moves against it (z -15.5)
definition: Ex_X = log1p(points played at this event before today) minus its expectation given the number of on-site matches, best of, tour and surface (fitted on seasons before 2013); x = Ex_A - Ex_B.
mechanism: Two-sided: real fatigue (-) or the market over-reading a struggle as decline (+).

name: Slam physical cost from tracking: distance run in earlier rounds beyond minutes
definition: Dist_X = metres run by X in this Slam's earlier rounds (US Open per set) residualised on minutes and sets; x = Dist_A - Dist_B.
mechanism: Score lines and durations are public, running is not; two three-hour matches differ in physical cost by style and opponent.

name: Serve-speed fade in the previous match (men)
definition: fade_X = first-serve speed in the last set of X's previous match minus its first set, minus X's own typical fade (shrunk); x = fade_A - fade_B.
mechanism: A speed drop late in a match is a fatigue or injury sensor that no score line shows.

name: Short off-season after a late finish to the previous season
definition: For a player's first three matches of a season: Off_X = days between his last match of the previous season and his first of this season; x = [log Off]_A - same_B; companion: pre-season match play (United Cup, exhibitions).
mechanism: Finals and Davis Cup Finals players lose their training block; the market sees ranking, not the calendar.

name: Alive in the doubles draw (future load)
definition: 1[the player's doubles team is still in this event's draw when the singles match starts], from results before it; x = diff; strongest at Slams and in late rounds.
mechanism: Two draws compete for one body late in the week; invisible to singles pricing.

name: Team-event doubles rubbers and tie travel
definition: Team_X = doubles rubbers at Davis Cup, BJK Cup and United Cup ties in the 21 days before (singles rubbers are already in sets_14d) plus 1[the tie was on another continent]; x = diff.
mechanism: Tour form guides leave out team ties' doubles and travel.

name: Exhibition match play
definition: Exhibition matches in the 21 days before (Six Kings Slam, UTS, Kooyong, World Tennis League and others flagged as exhibitions); x = diff.
mechanism: Match play outside the official record; the market sees the headline, not the load.

name: Tiebreak luck
model_overlap: low (diluted inside elo_overall, elo_games, points_52w; no tiebreak input)
exposed_2025_26: partly (weak): Stage 4's text sentence on the tiebreak record given Elo pools 2013-2026; no 2025-26 reading against a price used
disposition: built; folded into G1 through close-set luck (r 0.83)
definition: Per match: tiebreaks won minus sum over tiebreaks played of pi_TB(p_i, p_j, L), the iid tiebreak win probability at the two players' own serve-point rates in that match (L = 10 for Slam deciding tiebreaks under the rule, else 7; stage2_iid.tiebreak). Decayed sum over the player's earlier completed box-score matches at every level, weight 2^(-days/91) (secondary 365 d and flat 52 weeks); expectation curves frozen on 2010-2012; A - B; registered sign negative.
mechanism: Tiebreak outcomes are luck (season spread = pure iid spread, 2.28 tiebreaks for men 2013-24) but enter scorelines (straight sets), round reached, rankings and results-based ratings as wins; a 0.02-0.06 log-odds shift is below the margin, so sharps cannot bet it alone and the close keeps it

name: Results-rating luck gap (Elo on results minus Elo on points-implied results)
model_overlap: medium (elo_overall ~ R(y); ratings_iid points-based; the same-dynamics difference is not formable from them)
exposed_2025_26: partly: market_anchoring's men's decayed hold/break luck (uncalibrated iid) read on 2019-2025 (-0.01 [-0.10,+0.09] mLL) and 2026 (+0.28 [-0.07,+0.62]); I-025 itself unseen
lead_note: the close's loading is large and the outcome takes back little (beta ~ -0.2 c); orthogonal part ~0
definition: Run stage1_baselines' Elo twice over Stage 0: with the result y, and with Lambda_P substituted for y where a box score exists (logit Lambda_P = beta_tour,bo * (T_i - T_j)/sqrt(T_i + T_j), T = total points won, fitted once on 2010-12). Gap = R(y) - R(Lambda_P) pre-match, in log-odds; a third run with Lambda_G (games-implied) splits it into set luck R(y)-R(Lambda_G) and game luck R(Lambda_G)-R(Lambda_P). Companion decayed sums of y-Lambda_P, y-Lambda_G, Lambda_G-Lambda_P (h 91 d).
mechanism: Measures the luck a results-based rating (the kind openers and the public use) carries now, with Elo's own memory; the close over-rates the lucky if it leans on results

name: Break-point luck in four pieces (saved, faced, converted, chances created)
model_overlap: medium-high (form_bp_saved, form_bp_faced_pg, form_bp_conv, form_brk, iosO/D_bp_saved are raw rates = skill + luck)
exposed_2025_26: partly: motivated in part by edge_anatomy's 2025-26 ledger (men's holds -4.4, bp saved -3.9, two-week bp saved -2.8) and market_anchoring's 2019-2026 hold/break luck readings
lead_note: pieces separately are mirror pairs; chance creation reads against its sign
definition: Per match: save luck S - F*sbar(p_i); faced luck F - G*phibar(p_i); conversion luck C - Ch*(1 - sbar(p_j)); chance luck Ch - G_opp*phibar(p_j); sbar = weighted logistic of saves on logit p, phibar = iid break points per service game (f08_clutch.bp_per_game) times a tour constant, both frozen on 2010-12. Four decayed sums (h 91 d), A - B. Signs: save -, faced +, conversion -, chance -. Hold luck ~ save luck - (1 - sbar)*faced luck.
mechanism: The close credits holds; holding by saving break points (luck, persistence 0.07-0.11) is rated like holding by not facing them (skill, reliability 0.71). Luck reading of the men's serving-over-rated / returning-under-rated lead

name: Event-run luck and the flattering last scoreline
model_overlap: low (sets_14d mixes progress and luck; round)
disposition: G1 member (flattery); run luck not chosen
lead_note: run luck: c < 0 and the line moves against it before the close
definition: Run luck R = sum over the player's earlier matches at this event (qualifying included) of (y - Lambda_P); 0 with an indicator if none. Scoreline flattery F = logit(games share) - kappa*logit(points share) of the previous match, kappa the 2010-12 population slope. A - B; signs negative.
mechanism: Within an event the recreational market prices how the last match looked (straight sets, bagels); sharp models price points; a recreational close (BetOnline from Sep 2025) keeps more. Separates rhythm (+, U-138) from luck (-) in a deep run

name: Serve-speed state extensions (second serve, gap, fault speed, last-match fade)
model_overlap: medium for (a),(b),(d) (spd_L stage 2 is first-serve 28-day form); low for (c)
exposed_2025_26: partly: the family is motivated by the base signal's 2025-26 results (serve_speed_tabpfn, edge_anatomy)
disposition: registered protocol (partial data: ATP non-Slam per-point speeds need the P9 decryption)
definition: Each a 14-day mean minus own 364-day mean, per SD, event-year centred: (a) second-serve speed; (b) first-minus-second speed gap; (c) mean speed of first-serve faults minus first serves in; (d) last match's first-serve speed, last third of service points minus first third, against own normal fade, controlled for points played. A - B.
mechanism: Physical state (shoulder, fatigue, confidence) shows in the radar before results; unwatched data (M1); the base first-serve state replicated

name: Close-set and deciding-set luck
exposed_2025_26: partly (weak): as PS01 (Stage 4 pooled given-Elo text)
definition: Close-set luck: over sets that reached 5-5 (7-5, 5-7, 7-6, 6-7, long advantage sets), sets won minus sum of pi_55(p_i, p_j), the iid probability of winning a set from 5-5 averaged over both serving orders (includes the tiebreak). Deciding-set luck: deciding sets won minus pi_set(p_i, p_j, rule). Decayed sums, A - B, negative.
mechanism: Close and deciding sets are near coin flips under iid but read as toughness or fitness; results and rankings carry them

name: Ranking-points luck
model_overlap: low (points_52w is the actual points, not their luck share)
lead_note: partial data (ranking points table); lower rank
definition: Over the 52-week ranking window: sum of (y_k - Lambda_P,k) * dRP_k, dRP = ranking points for reaching the next round at match k's level and year (official tables), divided by the player's current ranking points; A - B; negative.
mechanism: Rankings drive seeding, the public's anchor and rank-based openers; luck in big-event rounds inflates them more than Elo

name: Games-route minus points-route rating matchup, luck direction (I-009 re-framed)
model_overlap: medium (iosO/D_hold in model; spw IOS not)
lead_note: needs the clock; I-009 failed a skill gate
definition: z_C2 - z_C1: match log-odds from the surface IOS hold ratings (via serve_rate_for_hold) minus from the spw IOS, remainder after projection on the inputs (f08_clutch.x_i009); registered NEGATIVE (luck), not + (skill).
mechanism: Long-memory hold/break records beyond what points imply are mostly luck; the close credits holds

name: Women's error state (WTA advanced statistics)
disposition: registered protocol (WTA advanced statistics, 2021-26; three discovery seasons)
definition: Unforced errors per point played in the last 14 days minus the player's own 52-week rate, event-year centred, per SD; A - B; sign negative (rising errors = declining state).
mechanism: Confidence or physical decline shows in errors before results; no market watches this feed

name: Return elasticity to server strength (non-additive matchup)
exposed_2025_26: partly: motivated by edge_anatomy's 2025-26 men's serving/returning asymmetry
lead_note: needs the clock and a reliability gate similar splits failed
definition: Per returner, shrunk slope of match return-point residuals (logit rpw minus IOS-predicted from the server's pre-match O and the returner's D) on the server's O; matchup term b_A*(O_B - Obar) - b_B*(O_A - Obar).
mechanism: Additive serve/return models (bookmakers' and ours) miss returners who hold up against big servers

name: Visible luck count: points-dominant losses minus fewer-points wins, last 10 matches
definition: Count of the last 10 matches lost while winning more total points, minus those won with fewer points; A - B; sign positive (unlucky = under-rated).
mechanism: The market sees the W/L column; points say otherwise

name: Cheap-wins share
definition: Share of the last 52 weeks' wins that came by opponent retirement or walkover (status); A - B; negative.
mechanism: Rankings and results-based ratings count them fully

name: Escapes: match points saved in recent matches
definition: Match points saved (score replay) in matches won over the last 8 weeks, minus match points failed to convert in losses; A - B; negative.
mechanism: A narrative of resilience the public pays for; under iid it is luck

name: Luck exposure as a price-slope modulator
definition: Sum over both players' recent tiebreaks and close sets of pi(1 - pi) (outcome-free luck variance), times the close's log-odds; context modulator.
mechanism: Noisy records deserve more shrinkage; the close may not shrink enough

name: Rally and return speed state from Hawk-Eye tracking
definition: Return speed (and spin) in the last 14 days minus own normal, event-year centred; A - B.
mechanism: Physical state in the rally (point-shot-ideas section 1)

name: Distance-run state (Slam feeds)
definition: Metres run per point in the previous match minus own normal; A - B.
mechanism: Fatigue carried into the next round

name: Serve-mechanics collapse in the last match
definition: Last match's double faults per serve point and first serves in, each minus own 52-week rate in SDs (no decay); A - B.
mechanism: A single bad serving day (yips, injury) before it shows in decayed form

name: Serve-return balance
definition: Serve share of dominance: iosO_spw deviation / (iosO_spw deviation + iosD_rpw deviation), A - B.
mechanism: If the close over-rates servers per se

name: Draw luck
definition: Ranking points earned in 52 weeks minus the points expected from the player's pre-match win probabilities against the opponents actually drawn; A - B; negative.
mechanism: Rankings ignore draw strength; the public anchors on rankings

name: Lower-level luck behind an arrival's ranking
definition: PS02's decayed match luck restricted to qualifying, Challenger and WTA 125 matches in 52 weeks; A - B; negative.
mechanism: Arrivals are under-rated on average (U-330); lucky Challenger runs inflate the ranking that partly corrects it

name: Totals-implied competitiveness (excess total)
model_overlap: medium (serve dominance known to IOS and ratings_iid; the net-of-IOS construction removes it; check R2 with the 56 inputs)
exposed_2025_26: no (market structure and an outcome-free <=2024 check only)
lead_note: the totals' late move +2.3 but -0.4 beyond the model; +1.8 with the curvature base
definition: excess = BetOnline total-games line minus its expectation given the moneyline (|logit p|, logit p^2), tour, best_of, surface, indoor, level and the pair's in-model serve levels (IOS hold and ace sums), fitted outcome-free on 2019-2024; enters as z(excess) x logit p_close (+ excess = the totals market expects a closer match than the moneyline). Members: excess at the open; total-implied minus moneyline-implied favourite strength (diff, inverted fit); totals move net of the moneyline-implied move.
mechanism: Moneyline and totals are bet by different money and settle differently (totals void on any retirement, moneyline has action after one set at Pinnacle and BetOnline); no arbitrage ties them, so a moneyline tilted by favourite or injury money is not corrected by the totals market, and the gap carries the market's own view of closeness and retirement risk.

name: Line momentum: the close's reaction to its own move
exposed_2025_26: no (bet_timing's 2025-26 move readings concern the model, not this statistic)
lead_note: no continuation at either book; fresh/stale split kept as a test-design note
definition: mv = logit p_close - logit p_open at one book (BetOnline: p_bol_open to p_bol_close; Pinnacle: OddsTrader id 20 opening p_ot20o to its close), oriented to A, RMS-scaled; tested beyond that book's own close, overall and by limit tier: tour, level (Slam/1000 vs 500/250), first match at the event vs later round, |L|.
mechanism: The close ends a constrained process: limits cap sharp money in low-limit segments (WTA, 250s, early rounds), so moves can stop short (momentum survives); public match-day money can overshoot (reversal). Neither is removed by the close itself.

name: Late steam and the line path
definition: From OddsTrader lineHistory (BetOnline; Pinnacle to Sep 2025): move in the last 3 h before the listed start, number of line changes, time of the last change; late_share = late move / total move. Tested beyond the close and, outcome-free, as move-so-far predicting the remaining move.
mechanism: Late moves carry warm-up, injury and highest-limit sharp money; whether the close over- or under-shoots them is untested; move-so-far predicting the rest is the 'beat the move' business.

name: Wind at the scheduled start, indoor as negative control
disposition: registered protocol (G3 extension; wind at the scheduled hour, indoor placebo)
definition: Mean wind speed and gusts (Open-Meteo archive, hourly) at the venue over [listed start, +2 h]; context z(wind) x logit p_close (prediction: flatter) and diff z(wind) x serve-strength gap (iosO_ace or iosO_first_won, A - B: the bigger server's edge shrinks). The same columns built for indoor matches from the outside weather are the placebo.
mechanism: Books price players, not weather; wind compresses serve dominance and adds error variance; BetOnline's last line is stamped over 60 min before the listed start in 30-43% of matches (observed), so the day's conditions often come after it.

name: Heat stress x age and climate of origin
model_overlap: low (age is an input; heat x age is not)
disposition: registered protocol (G3 extension; heat x age)
definition: Approximate WBGT from temperature, humidity and radiation (Open-Meteo) at the listed hour, outdoor; diff z(heat) x (age_A - age_B) and z(heat) x (home-climate gap: mean summer temperature of the player's country, A - B); indoor placebo.
mechanism: Heat costs are physiological and player-specific; ratings and prices carry no heat term; the 2026 ATP heat rule shows the issue is live.

name: Altitude x serve dominance and altitude experience
disposition: registered protocol (G3 extension; altitude x serve gap)
definition: Venue elevation (from the gazetteer's coordinates); diff 1[elevation > 500 m] x serve-strength gap (A - B) and x (matches above 500 m in the last 365 days, A - B, own sequence).
mechanism: Thin air speeds the ball and rewards big servers; adaptation takes days; books apply at most a venue reputation (Madrid, Gstaad, Kitzbuehel, Bogota, Guadalajara).

name: Finals-race pressure
lead_note: needs the clock; the related cliffs and points to defend were null
definition: For tour-level matches from August: each player's year-to-date race points (results x a per-year points table, or downloaded race standings) and the gap to the last qualifying place (ATP and WTA top 8) from results finished before es; states in_contention (gap <= points available in his remaining events), clinched, eliminated; diffs of in_contention and clinched.
mechanism: Incentives are discussed but not modelled: books' openers lean on ratings and rankings; a qualified player conserves, a contender pushes, an eliminated one may be on holiday.

name: Ranking cliffs: Slam seeding and direct entry
definition: For matches in the 4 weeks before a Slam's seeding ranking (seeds 1-32) or its entry-deadline ranking (direct entry about top 104): 1[rank 28-40] and 1[rank 90-120] at the match, signed by whether this round's points would cross the line; A - B.
mechanism: A seed avoids top-8 opponents for two rounds and a direct entry saves qualifying; the money and draw value are large, invisible to rating-based prices.

name: Points to defend
definition: Points the player earned at the same tournament last year (round reached x points table) divided by his ranking points, plus 1[defending champion]; A - B.
mechanism: Rolling 52-week rankings make last year's result a live stake; books do not price stakes.

name: Player's beat-the-close record
model_overlap: medium (IOS profile and form may explain persistent residuals; check R2)
exposed_2025_26: partly (the mechanism leans on edge_anatomy's 2025-26 finding that men's returning strength is under-rated)
lead_note: fails its reliability gate (split-half -0.04); the line chases it (+8.8)
definition: For each player, over his previous up to 60 priced main-tour matches (all with lf + 1 <= es), the shrunk mean of (result - closing probability) = sum(y - p) / (n + 30); members by role (as favourite, as underdog) and by surface; A - B. For Look A, a version frozen at 31 Dec 2024.
mechanism: Books' and bettors' player models share blind spots (style, returning, reputation); a player the close has kept mispricing may keep being mispriced. A catch-all for unnamed player traits.

name: Rest hours from the previous match
exposed_2025_26: partly (edge_anatomy found the schedule family unpriced in 2025-26)
definition: Hours between the previous match's estimated end (its listed start from OddsTrader dt_utc plus its minutes from Stage 0, imputed from games where missing) and this match's listed start, capped at 72; members 1[rest < 20 h] and 1[previous ended after 23:00 local and this starts before 15:00 next day]; A - B.
mechanism: Models and most bettors count days; tournament schedulers give stars the better slots; a late finish is followed by an overnight line posted with thin money.

name: Formation window (line age) as a stratifier
disposition: test design (freshness split in the registration)
definition: h_open = hours between BetOnline's first recorded line and the listed start (h_bol_open); context 1[h_open < 12]; registered as a stratifier for late-information statistics (MP-04, MP-11, MP-16): their coefficient expected larger where the line formed fast.
mechanism: Maturity takes time and money; later-round lines are posted after the previous round ends.

name: Polymarket informed flow (2025-26 only)
exposed_2025_26: yes (Polymarket 2025-26 closes and settled results, through 21 Sep 2026, inside the sealed window)
disposition: prospective only (2025-26 data; register now, read on matches after the registration date)
definition: Net stake toward A from wallets classified as clearly beating Polymarket's close using only markets settled before the window opens (polymarket_sharp_money's rule, walk-forward), placed 48-6 h before the listed start, divided by all stake in that window; plus Polymarket's price move over the window.
mechanism: No sportsbook shows who bets; on Polymarket the accounts that beat the close are visible, and their early money may hold information the books' close lacks (most of all for women, where BetOnline's 2026 line lagged the exchanges).

name: Edition pace learned this week
definition: Ace rate in this edition's matches completed before es (lf + 1 <= es) over the players' IOS expectation (shrunk by service games), times the pair's ace-offence gap (A - B); context version as a slope modifier.
mechanism: This year's balls, resurfacing and weather differ from the venue's history (Paris 2025 moved venue); bettors learn it from commentary; the price applies only part of serve-dominance scaling.

name: Doubles tells
definition: From TennisLive's listed doubles, name-linked to singles players: 1[gave a walkover or retired in doubles at this event or in the last 14 days], doubles sets in the last 3 days, 1[entered doubles here]; A - B.
mechanism: Markets and singles models watch singles; a doubles withdrawal is a cheap health tell rarely reported, and doubles load is invisible to singles histories.

name: Lucky loser late replacement
definition: 1[A is LL] - 1[B is LL] (Stage 0 entry) and its product with 1[BetOnline's first line < 8 h before the start]; plus the LL's qualifying matches here.
mechanism: The opponent prepared for someone else; the LL is warm; the line is posted late with low limits.

name: Pre-event injury withdrawals
definition: 1[withdrew from an event citing injury in the last 30 days] and days since, from Wikipedia edition pages' Withdrawals sections (or ATP/WTA entry lists); A - B.
mechanism: High-profile withdrawals are priced; mid-ranked players' withdrawals at 250s are not watched, and no layoff measure sees a two-week gap with a stated injury.

name: Attention and liquidity context
definition: Context: OddsTrader books with a pre-start line (<= 30 min after the listed start), h_bol_open, Polymarket pre-match stake (2025-26); modulators of other statistics.
mechanism: Thin markets price less information.

name: Public attention (fame) premium
lead_note: the clientele gate failed; popularity weak in the literature
definition: Wikipedia pageviews of the player's article: 30-day mean before the match as a log residual on his ranking, and the 7-day / 90-day surge; A - B.
mechanism: Recreational money follows names; a recreational book may shade popular players.

name: Night session x player's night record
definition: 1[local listed start >= 18:00] x the player's own shrunk night-minus-day residual; A - B.
mechanism: Cooler, heavier conditions under lights suit some games; not in ratings.

name: Exhibition and team-event load
definition: 1[played Laver Cup, United Cup, Davis Cup Finals or qualifiers, Six Kings Slam or UTS in the last 10 days] plus travel distance; A - B.
mechanism: Off-tour matches and travel are invisible to tour histories.

name: Slam first-round entrant with a health doubt
definition: 1[Slam first round] x 1[retired, gave a walkover or withdrew in the last 28 days]; A - B.
mechanism: First-round prize money draws entrants who are not fit.

name: Overnight close
definition: Context: listed start when both US Eastern (00:00-08:00) and central Europe (00:00-07:00) are asleep in the final hours; a modulator.
mechanism: Fewer bettors set the last price.

name: Settlement wedge (retirement risk), test design
definition: Score registered tests with retirements before a completed set treated as void (both books' moneyline rule) and report retirements separately; shrunk retirement hazard per player as a control.
mechanism: The close prices the bet the book settles; the model's target counts every retirement as a loss.

name: Stale benchmark close, test design
definition: Minutes between BetOnline's last recorded line and the listed start (bol_after_listed_min); stratify every late-information statistic's test: fresh (<= 60 min) vs stale.
mechanism: From 7 Sep 2025 the model's price is BetOnline's last recorded line, which can precede the start by hours, so late news looks 'unpriced'.

name: Outright-implied strength vs the match price
definition: Tournament-winner prices inverted into a strength (draw simulation), minus the match price's implied strength; A - B.
mechanism: Outrights are bet by other money and updated on other news.

name: Coaching change
definition: 1[announced coaching change in the last 60 days]; A - B.
mechanism: New-coach bounce or disruption; news-only.

name: Ball brand switch between consecutive events
definition: 1[this event's ball brand differs from the player's previous event's]; A - B.
mechanism: Players complain about ball changes; books ignore them.

name: Clutch-luck stock: break points and tiebreaks beyond the match's own point rates
model_overlap: medium (form_bp_saved, form_bp_conv, iosO_bp_saved, form_first_won, form_second_won); the orthogonal-part step decides
exposed_2025_26: partly: motivated by edge_anatomy's 2025-26 ledger of the in-model BP-saved rates (men z -3.9, -2.8), read by the lead and R1; the residual itself never read
definition: Per player, over completed matches with a box score in the 365 days before this one, sum with a 13-week half-life (no shrinkage) three residuals against that match's own serve-point rates p_s (player) and p_o (opponent) under iid points: BP saved - faced*p_s; BP converted - chances*(1-p_o); tiebreaks won - played*q with q = p_s(1-p_o)/[p_s(1-p_o)+(1-p_s)p_o]. Composite = mean of the three standardised stocks; A - B; expected sign negative.
mechanism: Break-point and tiebreak over-performance does not persist (luck), yet it moves W/L records, rankings, Elo and the 'clutch' narrative; the model's raw BP rates mix this luck with serving skill; the close over-rates men's BP saving in every era (edge_anatomy), consistent with luck read as skill.

name: Break-point luck piece
definition: RS01's first two residuals only (BP saved - faced*p_s; BP converted - chances*(1-p_o)), per 100 break-point opportunities, 13-week half-life, unshrunk; A - B.
mechanism: As RS01; the part most directly tied to the close's over-rating of men's BP saving.

name: Tiebreak luck piece
model_overlap: low (no tiebreak input in the model)
exposed_2025_26: partly: raw tiebreak rates (U-207) were scored on 2025-26 by the predictability diagnostic; this residual not
definition: Tiebreaks won minus sum over tiebreaks played of q(p_s, p_o) from each match's own serve-point rates, last 52 weeks (13-week half-life), plus tiebreaks played per match as exposure; A - B.
mechanism: Tiebreak wins are near coin flips but count fully in records, rankings and Elo; the model has no tiebreak input.

name: Deciding-set luck piece
exposed_2025_26: partly: U-207's deciding-set form was scored on 2025-26 by the predictability diagnostic (onM men -0.039, worse)
definition: Deciding sets won minus sum of the iid probability of winning a set at that match's own serve-point rates, over deciding sets played in the last 52 weeks; A - B.
mechanism: Deciding-set records regress strongly toward 45% + 0.2 x straight-set record; bettors read them as nerve.

name: Load spike against the player's own normal (acute:chronic ratio)
exposed_2025_26: partly: the schedule-and-body family's 2025-26 strength (edge_anatomy) shaped the choice; the ratio never read
disposition: built by the lead; not chosen
lead_note: it is sets_14d again (R^2 0.61; orthogonal -1.09), opposite to the researcher's sign
definition: log(G14 / max(Gch, floor)): G14 = games played (singles at every level, doubles where held) in the 14 days before this match's earliest start es; Gch = mean 14-day games over days 15-70 before; floor = tour median 14-day games of active players; plus a flag for ratio >= 1.5; A - B.
mechanism: The close and the model see absolute recent load (sets_14d), not load relative to the player's own normal; spikes cause injury and flat play before any news shows; the 12-day Masters (2023, 2025) raised spikes; record retirements in 2025.

name: Season load x age
definition: Games played in the last 52 weeks relative to the field's walk-forward norm (tour, week, ranking band), times max(0, age - 27), with an autumn (Sep-Nov) indicator; A - B.
mechanism: Older players recover more slowly from accumulated load; the close prices age uniformly.

name: Turnaround in hours, late finish, doubles since the last singles match
definition: H = hours from the end of the player's previous match (singles or doubles) to this match's scheduled start (end = Flashscore end_utc where present, else start_utc + Stage 0 minutes; doubles have start times only, so start + a typical duration); features min(H, 48) A - B, flag H < 20, previous finish after 23:00 local time, doubles matches since the last singles match.
mechanism: Books and models count days and sets, not clock hours; late finishes and same-day doubles are invisible in day counts.

name: Doubles load at the same event
definition: Doubles matches and sets the player played at this event, and in the 3 days before this singles match's scheduled start; A - B.
mechanism: Singles histories, ratings and most bettors ignore doubles minutes.

name: Draw shadow: a dominant player still alive, and the next-round shadow
disposition: built by the lead; not chosen
lead_note: it is the status axis (with rank > 50 jointly: -0.01)
definition: Dominant = as-of overall Elo >= 100 points above the field's 3rd-best entrant at the event's start; S = 1[another dominant player is still alive at es] x 1[player in Elo top 20, not dominant]; N = 1[a dominant player is the projected next-round opponent]; reverse term for players outside the top 50; each A - B.
mechanism: Effort and psychology in elimination draws respond to the draw beyond the current match; prices are set match-up by match-up; dominance concentrated again in 2024-26 (men).

name: Player's own translation ratio from lower levels to the tour
model_overlap: medium (the men's level layer; IOS profiles)
lead_note: a candidate extension of G4 (own translation ratio); persistence untested
definition: Men: opponent-adjusted total points won at Challenger level / at tour level over the last 36 months, shrunk toward the walk-forward global factor (~1.095) by matches at the scarcer level; women: WTA 125 vs tour; feature (ratio - global) x U-330's lower-level share; A - B.
mechanism: Rankings, Elo and a global level translation discount every player alike; the close under-rates arrivals from lower levels (growing by era); players whose lower-level form translates unusually are misjudged.

name: Ranking stakes: points to defend and distance to a threshold
definition: (a) Ranking points the player earned at this event last year (Stage 0 + the tours' points tables) / current points; (b) signed distance in places to the nearest live threshold at the match date (top 100/104 Slam entry, top 32 Slam seeding, Finals-race top 8 in Sep-Nov); (c) points for winning this round / points gap to that threshold; A - B.
mechanism: Tournament theory: effort follows each player's marginal stake; prices reflect level and round, not individual stakes; 2026 rules (18 counting results, fewer mandatory 500s) shift stakes.

name: Heat stress: heat-weighted recent load, and heat x age
definition: Outdoor WBGT at the venue and scheduled hour from hourly temperature, humidity, wind and radiation (Liljegren; Open-Meteo); (i) sum of minutes x max(0, WBGT - 25 C) over the last 3 days, A - B; (ii) WBGT at this match x (age_A - age_B); (iii) a 2026+ ATP heat-rule indicator.
mechanism: Simple lagged heat is priced (Burke); the interactions (heat x own minutes, heat x age) and the 2026 cooling-break rule are untested and may not be priced.

name: Edition court pace from Hawk-Eye bounces
disposition: registered protocol (G3 extension; edition pace from Court Vision bounces)
definition: Per venue-edition, the ball's horizontal speed retained and vertical restitution at the bounce from Court Vision tracking of earlier days' matches (released by the clock), giving a pace-rating analogue; feature = this edition's index - the venue's previous edition, x (A's serve dominance - B's).
mechanism: Court changes shift serve dominance (Paris, Shanghai 2025 per media); ace-based pace lags; a physical measure is new information.

name: Decline from own peak (men): serve speed and serve points
definition: Own 52-week mean first-serve speed minus own highest 52-week mean to date (system offsets as in the speed panel), and own 52-week opponent-adjusted serve points won minus own 3-year peak; A - B.
mechanism: The close over-rates older men; chronological age proxies a physical decline that varies by player.

name: Day-form volatility (pair steepness modulator)
exposed_2025_26: partly: predictive_frontier scored the reliability family through 2025
definition: Per player, time-decayed SD of match-level serve and return point residuals (observed minus expected from pre-match profiles) over the last 25 matches; pair term (sd_A^2 + sd_B^2) x the close's log-odds.
mechanism: Match outcomes are over-dispersed; prices and inputs carry means only.

name: Early-retirement risk under each venue's settlement rule
definition: Shrunk 24-month retirement + walkover rate, a flag for a retirement or walkover in the last 30 days, WTA physio events in the previous match, and age; A - B.
mechanism: Pinnacle voids early retirements (rule to verify), Polymarket pays the advancing player: a venue-specific gap, not an outcome edge against the close.

name: Recent withdrawal with an injury reason
definition: Flag for a withdrawal from, retirement in or walkover at an event in the last 28 days, split by stated reason (injury or illness vs schedule); A - B.
mechanism: The close has the news, the model does not: a defensive input that keeps the model from fighting a news-moved line, not an edge against the close.

name: Lucky-loser entry
definition: 1[entered as lucky loser] (and qualifier), A - B.
mechanism: Late entry and a reference-point loss; possibly a ranking lag the close already absorbs.

name: Pre-Slam effort and post-Slam letdown
disposition: pool (B-MOTIV): G2 is its post-Slam member
definition: U-283 and U-284's definitions (top-20 at a 250/500 within 8 days of a Slam; a Slam QF+ within 21 days), A - B.
mechanism: Effort saving before a Slam; fatigue or relief after a deep run.

name: Exposure to tiebreaks in the matchup (serve-dominance level)
definition: From the two players' predicted serve-point rates (profiles), P(at least one tiebreak) and expected tiebreaks under iid for the format, times the close's log-odds.
mechanism: When both hold easily, a skill edge converts less; the price may scale it imperfectly.

name: Night session and local start hour
definition: Local start hour (start_utc + venue time zone), 1[>= 18:00 local], and a day-to-night switch flag versus the player's previous match.
mechanism: Circadian effects on serving; night conditions (cooler, slower).

name: Eastward travel and jet lag (not recommended)
definition: Time zones crossed eastward since the previous event x days since arrival proxy; A - B.
mechanism: Circadian disruption.

name: Altitude and acclimatisation
definition: Venue elevation (Open-Meteo elevation/geocoding) and its change since the player's previous event, x serve profile.
mechanism: Thin air favours servers; arrivals from sea level may lag.

name: Wind at the scheduled hour
definition: 10 m wind speed and gusts at the venue and hour (outdoor), x both players' first-serve reliance, and as a pair steepness term.
mechanism: Wind adds variance and penalises serve-reliant players.

name: Ball switch between consecutive events (not recommended)
definition: 1[the ball model differs from the player's previous event]; count of ball types in the last 4 weeks.
mechanism: Adaptation to ball changes.

name: Coaching change
definition: 1[a dated coach start or split in the last 90 days]; A - B.
mechanism: A change in level before ratings adjust.

name: Women's serve-speed state
definition: As men's spd_L: 28-day minus long-run first-serve speed, A - B.
mechanism: State signal the men's model already uses.

name: Physical state from the rally (Hawk-Eye)
definition: Groundstroke speed, rally length and distance between hits against the player's own normal over the last 28 days; A - B.
mechanism: A physical state that box scores do not show.

name: Score-state resilience
definition: Per-player effects of being a set down or up and of the within-set lead on serve points (Kovalchik-Ingram model), pooled over 2-3 seasons; A - B.
mechanism: Response to the scoreboard is invisible in box scores.

name: Trust in the close (market-internal)
definition: Pinnacle's margin at the close; Pinnacle minus BetOnline de-vigged gap; books pricing; stale-close flag.
mechanism: Margins widen where information is unequal; a stale close carries less news.
